segments.summary: Reviewed every core line for CV-310 through CV-313 and the residual-cleanup boundary using exact and adversarial lenses. The units establish strong event, projection, snapshot, FileSafe, and runtime-schema authority boundaries, but leave material payload, lifecycle, concurrency, partial-failure, security-consumption, and executable-oracle details unresolved.

Reviewed every core line spanning CV-314 through CV-316, including the intervening deferred-contract addendum for investigation attachments, scheduler field naming, usage adjustments, snapshot identifiers, route objects, and governance record details. The text provides concrete auth, readiness, prompt, governance-state, and Usage-route contracts, while leaving token lifecycle, inbox and probe races, graph-patch atomicity, projection recovery, fallback routing, GUI failure truth, privacy lifecycle, and present behavior fixtures open.
